Translation

col. iv

C₀ iv 1' “Now, they (the people) should not hear the matter,

C₀ iv 2' (for) the gods have commanded an annihilation –

C₀ iv 3'–4' an evil act Enlil will do to the people.

C₀ iv 5'–6' In the assembly they decided about the Flood:

C₀ iv 6'–7' “By the day of the new moon we shall do the task!” (they said).

C₀ iv 8'–10' Atra-ḫasīs, kneeling in the presence of Ea, his tears were flowing.

C₀ iv 11'–12' Ea opened his mouth, addressed his servant:

C₀ iv 13'–14' “Firstly, you are crying for the people; secondly, you are kneeling (in prayer):

C₀ iv 15' You are (indeed) the one who reveres me!

C₀ iv 16'–17' There is a task to be done ­–

C₀ iv 18'–19' but you, you don’t know at all how to bring it to its completion”.
